start: ^There are thirteen extra mouths to feed tonight, and the road to Jerusalem is monitored by patrols.
^Mary sits at his feet listening, but someone must handle the bread, the water, and the structural security of this house.
^We are hiding people who have prices on their heads.

s: ^How long can your provisions hold out?

lazarus: ^He is the proof they want to destroy. A man who was dead four days walking around is a living problem for the Sadducees. We keep him out of sight.
storage: ^We have dried grain and oil for three days. If he does not enter the city openly soon, we will run out of cover.
